profile.name: MD Shoaib Khan
profile.subtitle: Full Stack Developer
profile.description: I design and build production-ready digital products for businesses and founders — from modern web and mobile experiences to secure backends, AI integrations, and cloud infrastructure that scales.

text: I help businesses and founders turn ideas into products people enjoy using - thoughtfully designed, solidly engineered, and built to scale with real business needs.

On the frontend, I craft responsive interfaces with React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, and TypeScript, plus mobile apps with Flutter and React Native. On the backend, I build secure APIs with Spring Boot, FastAPI, Node.js, and Django, connected to PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and MySQL, and deployed on AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and Vercel.

I integrate AI where it creates measurable value: LLM workflows, vector search, NLP, computer vision, and automation that saves time. I also deliver e-commerce platforms, real-time apps, third-party integrations, Telegram bots, and custom business systems - with clear communication, clean code, and reliable milestones from planning to delivery.

experience.description: Building scalable full stack applications, REST APIs, and AI integrations for clients worldwide — using React, Next.js, Spring Boot, FastAPI, Node.js, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
Designed and developed responsive websites and REST APIs for startups and agencies. Improved performance, SEO, and user experience across client projects.
Created pixel-perfect UIs from Figma designs, implemented modern JavaScript frameworks, and collaborated remotely with design and backend teams.
